prompt: What is the area of a circle with radius $6$?
hint: Area of a circle is $\pi r^2$.

hints.text: Area of a circle is $\pi r^2$.

learningObjective: Compute the area of a circle from its radius.
explanation: Choice A, $12\pi$, is the *circumference* ($2\pi r$) — the classic mix-up.
Choice D squares the diameter instead of the radius.

alternativeExplanations.title: Area squares, circumference does not
steps: Area $= \pi r^2$ has an exponent, so the answer grows with the square of the radius.
If a question mentions units, area is square units and circumference is plain units — another way to tell which formula is wanted.
